use_cases.title: Predictive Maintenance for Hydro and Wind Assets
use_cases.description: Implement AI models that analyze sensor data from hydro and wind turbines to predict component wear and schedule maintenance before failures occur, reducing downtime and extending asset life.
use_cases.expected_value: Improved reliability of power generation, lower maintenance costs, and increased availability of renewable energy for distribution.

use_cases.title: AI‑Driven Demand Forecasting and Dynamic Pricing
use_cases.description: Use machine learning to forecast short‑term electricity demand and adjust pricing signals in real time, helping balance supply and demand across the grid and encouraging efficient consumption.
use_cases.expected_value: Enhanced grid stability, reduced peak load pressure, and better alignment of renewable supply with consumer demand.

use_cases.title: AI‑Powered Workforce Scheduling and Skill Matching
use_cases.description: Apply AI to match the 77 employees’ skills with operational tasks and optimize shift schedules, ensuring that the right expertise is available when needed.
use_cases.expected_value: Higher workforce productivity, reduced overtime costs, and improved employee satisfaction.
